svg.aria-label: Growth-curve analysis: doubling exponents, 32-bit nonce inversion times, and AICc model selection across 7 SAT tracks

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Growth-Curve Fits, 32-Bit Nonce Inversion Times & Sub-Exponential Model Selection
Shifted pure exponential M1: T(k) = c₀ + a·2^(αk) vs. polynomial (M2), √k (M3), and stretched-exp (M4) · 64-round FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (1C)
A. Fitted Scaling Exponent α (base b = 2^α per bit)
Solid bar: uncensored M1 (Frobenius k=14..32) · Diamond: Tobit MLE (+3 T/Os)
B. Full 32-Bit Nonce Inversion Time T(32) [log scale]
Measured 1C (3.3–4.2 min) vs. Extrapolated CDCL (days) · 3,367×–111,922× gap
C. Sub-Exponential Hypothesis Test: ΔAICc = AICc(M1) − AICc(Mⱼ) (Values > +2 Required to Beat Pure Exponential M1)
Pure exponential M1 wins 6/7 full tracks directly; .cnf k=14..32 (+2.1§) is solely the +0.6s k=25 probe seam (single-path k=14..24: −3.6, k=25..32: −15.9)
